item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. The implementation has now been exercised across default tests, all runtime features, the package-level feature matrix, deterministic fault injection, randomized crash/restart runs, and focused API boundary cases.

The audit remains at 27 confirmed findings. The most consequential are:

- LFU cache resynchronization producing different values at the same decided index,
- delta-snapshot state corruption,
- `AcceptSync` moving a decided index backward,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive partial replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

All evidence, including exact commands and retained outputs, is organized in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
